target: Arithmetic mean of accepted instantaneous PEI on-island load readings in each UTC hour, MW; not metered hourly energy
timezone: America/Halifax; historical wall-clock assumption, checked against current feed Unix timestamp
load_availability_rule: Hourly interval must end at or before issue minus one hour; publication latency is an assumption, not a recorded vintage
weather: Open-Meteo GFS seamless temperature at fixed 48-hour lead; deliberately older than issue time, not observed future temperature
initial_interval_calibration: Trailing 180 days ending at the first test issue minus one hour; exact boundaries in folds.csv
refit_schedule: Quarterly; trailing three years before a separate trailing 180-day interval calibration window
candidate_selection: Lowest hourly MAE on January-June 2024 only; no hyperparameter changes based on test results
primary_metric: MAE MW on identical eligible hours for every method
interval: 90% nominal symmetric split-conformal residual interval; empirical coverage, no exchangeability guarantee for time series
peak_definition: Training-target 95th percentile in each quarterly fold; statistical high-load threshold, not grid capacity
data_exclusions: Causal flatline flag only once elapsed repeated-reading duration reaches four hours; gaps over 30 minutes reset the run. Earlier readings never retroactively rejected. Other quality gates unchanged; no target interpolation.
limitations: No recorded electricity publication vintages; weather fixed-lead archive is not exact issue-run reconstruction; excluded poor-data periods; no utility endorsement or proven cost savings
revision_recorded: 2026-11-16, before revised-method fits; original 2025/26 scores were already inspected
evaluation_status: Post-audit retrospective reanalysis, not a fresh untouched holdout. Original model selection remains January-June 2024.
linear_benchmark: Original fixed Ridge(alpha=100), training-only scaling, same quarterly training windows, features and eligible target hours as original boosting

winter_revision.status: Exploratory retrospective comparison; no parameter search on 2025/26
winter_revision.point_model: Original selected boosting configuration; refit monthly on trailing three years of labels available one hour before issue; no 180-day gap
winter_revision.calibration: Signed out-of-sample errors from earlier monthly fits, trailing 365 days, minimum 500 rows; equal-tail 5th/95th empirical quantiles, conservative order statistics; no time-series coverage guarantee
winter_revision.warmup: Monthly historical predictions from January 2023; scored comparison January 2025 onward
winter_revision.selection_rule: One specified revision, report even if worse; do not replace original headline by best test score
winter_revision.future_validation: Log new forecasts before outcomes; 2025/26 cannot be made untouched again
